# HomeCloud Docs — https://docs.web.holab.abrdns.com/
# Spec: https://llmstxt.org/

> HomeCloud platform documentation: console, CLI, SDK, storage (SO), image registry (IR), queues (MQ), functions, mail, and operations.

## Getting started

- [Overview](https://docs.web.holab.abrdns.com/getting-started/overview/): What HomeCloud is and how the pieces fit
- [Accounts](https://docs.web.holab.abrdns.com/getting-started/accounts/): Account number, alias, ROOT, and members
- [Access Keys](https://docs.web.holab.abrdns.com/getting-started/access-keys/): Data-plane credentials for CLI/SDK

- [configure](https://docs.web.holab.abrdns.com/cli/commands/configure/)

- [mq](https://docs.web.holab.abrdns.com/cli/commands/mq/)
- [Releases](https://docs.web.holab.abrdns.com/cli/releases/)
